commit_message: Align SFTP confirmations with shared y-n input

replacements.old:
TXT_SFTP_MENU_UNINSTALL_CONFIRM = "Really uninstall all active SFTP users?
This will remove all SFTP user accounts currently active on the system.
This action does not modify the configuration, so you can use 'Apply changes'
afterwards to reinstall users according to the current configuration.

Proceed [y/N]"

TXT_SFTP_MENU_UNINSTALL_CONFIRM = "Opravdu odinstalovat všechny aktivní SFTP uživatele?

a uživatele znovu nainstalovat podle aktuální konfigurace.

Pokračovat [a/N]"
